verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a feature-flag management platform, but the evidence never documents a capability to act on many flags, members, or other resources in one operation. The CLI, MCP server, and scoped API tokens only show single-resource management or developer building blocks a user could script, and segment-based targeting is a different feature. None of these count as bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
